title: Roamers' route graph
description: The routes the roaming legendaries move between and their links (docs/paperwhite2/design/roaming-legendaries.md). Each route is a town map place (res/town_map/, a route place) and its outdoor zones are the zones whose header names that place (res/field/zones/, map type 0). Links go both ways and need only be listed on one side: a link is two routes a player walks (or surfs, or sails) between through at most a town or a bridge. tools/paperwhite2/roamers.py reads it with roamers.json.
